newsitem.title: MEXICO: Shell names Scott Roberts new president in Mexico.
newsitem.headline: Shell names Scott Roberts new president in Mexico.

text.p: Shell Oil said Scott Roberts has been named president of its Mexico operations, the company said in a statement Tuesday.

Formerly manager of business development at Shell Chemical's Houston offices, Roberts has worked for the oil company since 1973. He began at Shell as a chemical engineer, then managing divisions of the firm's chemicals, refining, plastics and resins operations.
Roberts was replacing Joaquin Moreno Uribe, who left the position after three years to become director general of Shell in Colombia, the company said.
Shell Mexico is a subsidiary of Royal Dutch/Shell Oil .
